purpose: Superseding current-state control for source-universe execution readiness. This record corrects stale implementation-stack planning state without rewriting the historical backlog.

Operational live due-cycle validation executes and succeeds.
A fresh scheduled live job reaches collector execution after validation.
Run steps and logs are retained and retrievable for audit.
A controlled live acquisition executes under the exact current Workbench network-authorization contract.

required_actions: Restore hosted runner execution and obtain fresh step-level evidence.
Execute a fresh controlled live acquisition on the exact current Workbench pin with both live environment gate and verified digest-bound authorization packet.
Deliberately resolve and verify the live-shadow content-safety scanning boundary before treating the path as production-ready.

boundary: This control records current implementation and operational readiness only. Merged code, replay fixtures, staging, adjudication bridges, Source materialization, or monitoring proposals do not establish live retrieval, candidate acceptance, monitor creation, scientific truth, registry completeness, assessment effect, canonical publication, or operational health.
